probes.asks: what are this lattice's own numbers - how many ways out of a point, how many charges a pulse lets go, how long a turn takes?
probes.found: fcc-12: D = 3, DEG = 12, SHEET = 6, CYCLE = 6 - counts, not measurements

measured.name: D
measured.note: how many dimensions fcc-12 has

measured.name: DEG
measured.note: the ways out of a point on fcc-12 - the exits it has, counted

measured.name: SHEET
measured.note: the exits with no component along the pulsing axis, which is what a source emits over. NOT DEG, which is 12

measured.name: CYCLE
measured.note: how many steps go round the ring of a turn on fcc-12

measured.name: slice
measured.note: a turn sweeps a PLANE, and a plane needs two dimensions - so what a turn lives in is min(D, 2), which is 2 here and stops growing at 2 however many dimensions are added

measured.name: \bar{c}
measured.note: a step's worth of lean is what one annihilation buys a path, and a step is \bar{c} - one cell a tick, the lattice's own speed. Its value in those units is one, which is a statement about the units and not about the quantity

steps.because: you do not know which side you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each and what you see is the two beating against one another - their difference. The halves cancel out of the difference, which is why the answer does not depend on them being exactly a half but the WAVELENGTH does
the branch that set out ahead of the source is compressed by its motion - the retarded time carries a 1/(1 - v), which to first order in a small speed is 1 + v
ahead is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 + v, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
the branch behind is stretched by the same motion by the same amount the other way - 1/(1 + v), which to first order is 1 - v
behind is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 - v, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out

beat.says: the difference between the two branches

ahead.says: the branch that set out ahead of the source

behind.says: the one that set out behind it

v.says: how fast the source is going

\\bar{c}.says: a step - one cell a tick

probes.found: cubic-6: D = 3, DEG = 6, SHEET = 4, CYCLE = 4 - counts, not measurements

measured.name: D
measured.note: how many dimensions cubic-6 has

measured.name: DEG
measured.note: the ways out of a point on cubic-6 - the exits it has, counted

measured.name: SHEET
measured.note: the exits with no component along the pulsing axis, which is what a source emits over. NOT DEG, which is 6

measured.name: CYCLE
measured.note: how many steps go round the ring of a turn on cubic-6

measured.name: slice
measured.note: a turn sweeps a PLANE, and a plane needs two dimensions - so what a turn lives in is min(D, 2), which is 2 here and stops growing at 2 however many dimensions are added

measured.name: \bar{c}
measured.note: a step's worth of lean is what one annihilation buys a path, and a step is \bar{c} - one cell a tick, the lattice's own speed. Its value in those units is one, which is a statement about the units and not about the quantity

steps.because: you do not know which side you are on, so both branches are there at half weight each and what you see is the two beating against one another - their difference. The halves cancel out of the difference, which is why the answer does not depend on them being exactly a half but the WAVELENGTH does
the branch that set out ahead of the source is compressed by its motion - the retarded time carries a 1/(1 - v), which to first order in a small speed is 1 + v
ahead is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 + v, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
the branch behind is stretched by the same motion by the same amount the other way - 1/(1 + v), which to first order is 1 - v
behind is not a primitive of this theory - it is 1 - v, so it stands in for itself here and the result is multiplied out
